basic_details.job_title: Prasar Bharati Senior Correspondent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Prasar Bharati (India's Public Service Broadcaster), through Doordarshan News, is engaging one Senior Correspondent for DD News/DD India, to be stationed at RNU DDK Kolkata, on a full-time contract for two years at a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 80,000/- to Rs 1,20,000/- (negotiable). Candidates need a degree in Journalism/Mass Communication or one of the other qualifications listed below, at least 8 years' experience in the relevant field, and must be below 45 years. content_sections.heading: About Prasar Bharati Senior Correspondent
content_sections.text: Prasar Bharati describes itself as India's Public Service Broadcaster, and its Secretariat is at Prasar Bharati House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi. This Notice Inviting Applications (NIA), File No. [E- 351070] A-10/16/68/2026-TM&SO dated 20.11.2026, is issued for Doordarshan News. The Senior Correspondent will work for DD News/DD India and will be based in Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks for experienced and dynamic persons. A candidate must hold one of the following educational qualifications: Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from recognised University/Institute OR Degree in any discipline and PG Diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication from recognised Institute OR Master's Degree in Journalism/Mass Communication from recognised University/Institute Proficiency: Bilingual in Hindi and English (preferably with knowledge of respective regional language). Experience: At least 8 years experience in relevant field. Age: Below 45 years as on date of notification. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Age, experience and education will be considered till the date of issue of this NIA (inclusive), which is 20 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs 80,000/- to Rs 1,20,000/- and is marked negotiable. The services will be purely on contractual basis, and the person engaged shall have no claim, implicit or explicit, for absorption or regularization in Prasar Bharati. The engagement is on full time basis; the person will not be allowed to take up any other assignment during the contract. The period of engagement shall initially be for two year, with an annual appraisal, and may be extendable based on the requirement of the organization and performance review. Either side can discontinue or terminate the engagement with one-month notice or one month's salary in lieu thereof, without assigning any reason. No claim of pensionary benefit on account of this contractual engagement shall be admissible.

content_sections.heading: Prasar Bharati Senior Correspondent Job Description
content_sections.text: Reporting, filing the stories and Newsroom related work. Providing inputs (including live inputs) in Hindi and English. Keeping a close eye on the social, economic and political developments of the states so as to keep the channels abreast about the latest issues. Persons engaged on contract basis can be assigned additional task apart from the specific tasks for which they are engaged.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Prasar Bharati Senior Correspondent
content_sections.text: Apply online on the Prasar Bharati web link https://avedan.prasarbharati.org ; the NIA is to be published under the DD News account on the Avedan Portal. Upload a complete and clear copy of all requested documents; otherwise the candidature shall be rejected without any intimation. Submit the application within 15 days from the date of publication on the PB Website (about 5 December 2026, 15 days from 20 November 2026). In case of any difficulty in submission, e-mail your concern with a screenshot of the error to [email protected] and [email protected] . Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Prasar Bharati reserves the right to conduct a test and/or interview of the shortlisted candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email. No TA/DA etc. will be paid for attending the test/interview.
